items.title: Donovan says Noah, Horford, and Brewer passed on the NBA for one more season despite being virtual locks to be drafted, so Taurean Green could achieve his dream. Green was eventually selected 52nd overall in the 2007 NBA Draft.
items.author: Existing-Sky9914
items.body_excerpt: Billy Donovan : “The only reason they came back was because of Taurean Green. Taurean couldn’t go. He wasn’t going to get drafted. Joakim Noah and Al Horford said, ‘No man left behind.’” “They felt like if they all left, Taurean would be left there unable to realize his dream.”…

items.author: KeithSmithNBA

Here's what the Warriors are working with (factoring in Al Horford's new deal, plus Yaxel Lendeborg):

$43.7M under the luxury tax
$51.7M under the first apron

Should have the $15M NTMLE, plus lots of flexibility to take on salary in trades. Keep an eye on the first apron being a likely hard cap.
